description:
The image depicts a collection of vintage wooden skis and other items leaning against a fence in front of a house. The skis, with their light-colored wood and pointed tips, are the main focus of the image. They are adorned with metal bindings and have a few red stripes running along them.

To the left of the skis, there is a red metal object that appears to be a ladder or a rack. Behind the skis, there are several white wooden shutters with peeling paint
